title: Holy priest: no shield on a Balance-talent druid in Dire Bear Form when a Protection paladin tank is also in the group (#1553)

rules.desc: Regression guard for #1553: a Holy priest casts no Power Word: Shield on a Balance-talent druid in Dire Bear Form above the critical band in combat, with a Protection paladin hired as a second tank in the group
rules.why_expect: this pinned #1553, and #1553 is fixed (TortoiseBots 5f57e84f2, PR #1557), so the expectation is PASS: the trial now guards the fix. The bug reproduced only with a second tank: with the hired paladin in the party, HasOtherTank (AiFactory.cpp:520-576) returns true for the druid and GetPlayerRoles (:597-611) returns GetTalentRoles(player) = Balance = DPS instead of reading Dire Bear Form as TANK, so the priest shielded a tank read as a DPS above the critical band. PriestActions.h:43-49 now passes TankForShield(..., druid && (HasAura 5487 || 9634)) into ShouldShieldTarget (ShieldTargetPolicy.h:23-39): the bear form counts as a tank whatever GetPlayerRoles says. Tortoise-trials measured 16 shields before the fix and 0 after, and the bench-fix-1111 run had 0 in all 3 valid reps. A shield above critical is the regression; min_reps 3 because previous rounds let one valid rep decide the trial

rules.desc: Precondition: Dire Bear Form (aura 9634) stays on the player through the fight, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the runner re-casts the stance and excludes time without it
